Frontend desktop (1920x1080): (a) Dashboard trend-range toggle 4/12/52 fires /api/dashboard/trend?weeks=N for each click — all 3 URLs captured; (b) Admin > Invites tab Bulk import button opens dialog with data-testid='bulk-invite-dialog', bulk-csv-input textarea pre-populated with 'email,claimant_label,note' header, and 'Import & email' button — visible & functional; (c) Claimants page after seeding Primary with sms_enabled=true+sms_verified=false shows 'Verify phone →' button which opens OTP dialog Step 1 with phone input (data-testid='otp-phone-input'), Send code button (data-testid='otp-send-button') enabled when phone starts with +, plus Twilio trial notice.

design_issues.screen: Admin > Bulk invite dialog & OTP dialog
issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent — accessibility hint, not blocking. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby.

action_items: Optional: add aria-describedby / <DialogDescription> to bulk-invite-dialog and otp-dialog to silence Radix Dialog a11y warnings.

Optional: Resend webhook is public (no signature verification) — for production, verify the Svix signature in `Webhook-Signature` header (Resend uses Svix). Currently any unauthenticated POST can disable reminders for a target email. Consider raising priority before public exposure.
Optional: bulk invite CSV size is unbounded — consider a max rows guard (e.g. 500) to prevent runaway Resend sends + DB writes.
critical_code_review_comments: send_sms_rate_limited inserts sms_log only when Twilio succeeds — so a successful trial-blocked Twilio (e.g. 'unverified number') does NOT throttle the next attempt. For OTP this is acceptable (user retries), but if Twilio returns success for an unreachable number you could still hammer it. Low risk.
Resend webhook lacks signature verification — see action item.
PDF logo embed adds ~290KB ASCII85+FlateDecode XObject — acceptable but consider downscaling the source PNG (currently produces 728x360 image) to reduce per-report payload.

OTP code generated with stdlib `random.randint` instead of `secrets.randbelow(1000000)` — predictable enough that brute force is still bounded by 10-min expiry + single-use, but `secrets` is the convention for auth tokens.
bulk_invite uses lc.get('claimant_label') or lc.get('label') — good fallback. Header row 'email,claimant_label,note' is documented in UI placeholder.
dashboard trend cap at 52 is implemented (verified weeks=200 returned ≤52).
/sms/verify-otp returns 400 for wrong/expired/used — uniform error code per spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on round-4 flows (trend toggle, bulk-invite dialog, OTP dialog step 1)

rca of the issue: No bugs found. One initial test failure was test-script-only: PDF 'UNOFFICIAL' string is buried inside ASCII85+FlateDecode-compressed content stream — fixed by decoding both wrappers before grep.
